title: Among all molecules that contain at least one oxygen atom and have at least
question: Among all molecules that contain at least one oxygen atom and have at least one double bond, which carcinogenic label ('+' or '-') is more common? Return the label that appears most frequently.

prediction.sql:
SELECT m."XCL_011"
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_010"
      AND a."XCL_003" = 'o'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b."XCL_005" = m."XCL_010"
      AND b."XCL_006" = '='
)
GROUP BY m."XCL_011"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
